rule_or_pattern: Normalise the catechism question/answer markers at line start: ^(?:Ε['΄’]?ρ|Εἰρ)\. → 'Ἐρ.' and ^Α['΄’]?π\. → 'Ἀπ.' (the print has the breathing on the capital, typeset after it). Everything else KEEP; the ς-for-στ cases (Ἀποςόλου 21, πίςεως 37, μυςήριον 38) are covered by the pool στ rule.
notes: 1860 polytonic catechism; the body text reads correctly with breathings and accents (5, 7-14, 16-20, 22-24, 30-34, 36-40). The 'Ἐρ.' / 'Ἀπ.' markers that open many lines are transcribed four inconsistent ways ('Ερ.', 'Ε΄ρ.', 'Ε'ρ.', and once 'Εἰρ.' in 2; 'Απ.', 'Α'π.', 'Α΄π.'), losing or misplacing the breathing. Line-initial 'Ὁ' in 27 is also read as bare 'Ο'.
